notes.title: Valentines Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743342/cde5733cc4aaeab09edab842b7b16f154f0d708e.png[/img]

👾 Minor bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Item Icons in the hotbar no longer change when clicked.
[*] Reworked option menus; No irrelevant options and a better layout for adjusting volumes.
[*] Smoother screen transitions.
[*] Several minor visual adjustments.
[*] Several minor QoL adjustments.
[/list]

👾 New Features:
[list]
[*] New NPCS, Beggar & Mystic.
[*] INSPECTs and interactives now have an alternative prompt when the hunter's drunk.
[*] New interactions with Ax, Will, and Wan.
[*] Companions now have an affection gauge.
[*] New Interactives around 2F.
[*] New 'Spooky encounter' in 2F.
[*] New Collectibles.
[*] New Librarian scene.
[*] New Nightmare Sequences.
[*] New Secret Cutscene.
[*] 'Hunter Quest' expansion.
[/list]

What started as a short 3-month project, has turned into a multi-year long endeavor, there are still several bugs to tackle and many new scenes to come! Please look forward to the final release of Rose Bullet, later this year.

notes.title: Not dead, just resting.
notes.content:
[b]Greetings all![/b]

First, I'd like to apologize for the long period of silence.
Worry not, the game is not dead, just resting!

To keep a long story short, a handful of factors have kept me from finishing this last update, and to make matters worse, there's this "[i]upcoming new expansion for a critically acclaimmed MMO[/i]" that's sure to keep me busy for the next couple months.

But fret not! 
Development is planned to pick up pace in August, aiming for a full release during Halloween season!
This final version will include new areas, puzzles and endings!
Stay tuned for further updates!

PS: I'll be joining my dear friend ZeldaMomoe on her [url=https://www.twitch.tv/ZELDAMOMOE]Twitch channel[/url] for a Pride-month commemorative playthrough of Rose Bullet! this Tuesday (June 18!) 9pm ET. Tune in!

notes.title: DevLog - Patch 0.9.8
notes.content:
Greetings all!

First, I'd like to apologize for how slow Dev has been. 
This patch may not feel as hefty, but it should address some severe issues from previous builds. With that said, there are some nuggets of new content here and there, but most notably:

- Art Gallery
- Awake Mode
- New Game +

These two later features are prone to bring forth a whole new slew of bugs!
I count on the community to report these and I'll promise you to swiftly fix it.

I have no final date for this project's completion, but I am doing my best to make it happen sooner than later. Stay tuned for future updates, and thank you for supporting Rose Bullet!

notes.title: DevLog - Bad News & Good News
notes.content:
[b][h3]DevLog #8 - Bad News & Good News[/h3][/b]
Greetings All! I've got bad news and good news!

[b]The bad news is Rose Bullet's final release is being delayed.[/b] 
Development was meant to resume this February, but I picked up a Game this February 1st and couldn't put it down. (That's Granblue Fantasy Relink for those who want to know).

Development has picked up, and it'll be ready soon, just not today.

Here's what you can expect these following weeks:
- Awake Mode update, Featuring a fully functional hard mode!
- Gallery update, Collect artwork through the game and review them in the gallery!
- Bug fixes.

[b]The good news is I'm laying out the roadmap for Rose Bullet 2.0![/b]
After the game is done, it will receive small, monthly updates, building up a more complete experience of the game! Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743342/8a558f13054213c510cff7ec3d6a4a9907d1873b.png[/img]

Rose Bullet 2.0 date is set for this year's Halloween season!
It is not a definite date, but I hope you're excited for even more Rose Bullet content!

Stay tuned! More updates these following weeks!

notes.title: Happy Holidays! - Final Release Date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743342/43c28c2036004a389740e1e4cbc983d272c5c25f.png[/img]

[b]Greetings All![/b]

Rose Bullet Dev has been on halt for the past week. 

The crunch burnout caught up to me while rushing to finish it before the holiday season, but alas, this project (like all my projects) ended up being more ambitious than anticipated. I am taking the rest of this year off to rest and will resume development early January!

The final release date for Rose Bullet is set for FEBRUARY 14. [b]Valentine's day![/b]
I believe this will give me plenty of time to finish and polish the game to a more ideal state.
Thank you so much for supporting this project! Enjoy the holiday season, and see ya soon! ♥
